doc.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017

title: Closing remarks
summary: Mullins hopes for more publicity for jazz; thanks and goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well that’s a good note to end on. All right.

Well I hope that you remember all I said to you, because I think that’s probably one of our — we don’t get enough publicity. A lot of people don’t even know about us. And I’m hoping every year, I’m hoping that the tide will turn.
Well that’s part of the reason why we’re doing this. So thanks a lot for talking to me today.
Yeah. I appreciate it man. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
